item.title: Congo eyes new subsea cable to fix Internet disruptions
item.description: On today's Techpoint Digest, we discuss Congo's plans for a new subsea cable to address Internet disruptions, X, and Paystack's evolution beyond a payments company.

item.title: Do African VCs really lack conviction, or are they playing a different game?
item.description: Terra Industries’ seed round reignited claims that African VCs lack ambition, but a closer look suggests the story is less about fear and more about structural constraints.

item.title: Egypt ends duty-free mobile phone exemption for incoming passengers
item.description: Egypt has scrapped the duty-free phone allowance for travelers, citing booming local manufacturing. The move, effective Wednesday, has sparked criticism from lawmakers concerned about its impact on expatriates.

item.title: From ₦36k to CEO: Jane Egerton-Idehen on building wealth through tech careers
item.description: Jane Egerton-Idehen started in tech earning ₦36k as a corps member, running 24/7 satellite shifts for extra pay. Now MD/CEO of NIGCOMSAT, she advises: chase challenging opportunities and skills first, financial growth will follow.

item.title: Nigeria’s telecoms regulator licenses seven new ISPs in Nigeria
item.description: On today's edition of Techpoint Digest, we talk about NCC licencing seven new ISPs in Nigeria, why she chose tech over oil and gas, and how Nigeria is leading the world in AI use.

item.title: Nigeria posts lowest funding share among Africa’s big four as startups raise $3.8bn in 2025
item.description: Nigeria recorded its lowest funding share among Africa’s four largest startup markets in 2025, taking just eight percent of the continent’s $3.8 billion in disclosed funding.

item.title: Worldcoin deletes Kenyans’ biometric data following court order
item.description: Worldcoin has deleted all biometric data collected from Kenyans after a High Court ruled the project’s data practices unlawful.

item.title: AfCFTA Secretary-General, Nigeria’s Finance Minister to headline Africa Business Convention 2026
item.description: The Secretary-General of the AfCFTA, and Nigeria’s Minister of Finance and Coordinating Minister of the Economy, will lead key conversations at the Africa Business Convention (ABC) 2026, scheduled for February 3–4.

item.title: Andela acquires Woven, strengthens AI engineer assessment capabilities
item.description: Andela has acquired Woven, a technical assessment company, to deepen its AI-focused hiring capabilities as global demand rises for engineers who can build and deploy AI systems at scale.
